agentic_result.reasoning_trace: 1. Identify the focal bright DWI signal. 2. Recognize that it is compatible with acute ischemic injury. 3. Answer yes, while noting that the vessels are not directly assessed.
evidence_used: Focal increased signal on DWI in one cerebral hemisphere
Appearance is compatible with restricted diffusion and acute ischemic injury
agentic_result.verification_notes: The yes/no answer is appropriately formatted. Multiple bright foci in the right cerebral hemisphere support suspected ischemic vascular pathology. The explanation appropriately notes that the vessels are not directly assessed and describes ischemia as suggestive rather than definitive.
issues_found: The explanation describes a single focal area, whereas multiple DWI-hyperintense foci are visible in the right cerebral hemisphere.

agentic_result.suggested_disclaimer: These findings suggest acute ischemic injury; ADC correlation and review of the full MRI are needed for confirmation.
